description:
Stand up a private STAGING instance that is a NEUTRALIZED copy of a live
    instance already on this box - its own db/port/systemd/nginx, sharing the Odoo
    binary + PostgreSQL. The SOURCE is strictly READ-ONLY (dumped + its filestore
    tarred; never dropped/altered/neutralized). Flow on confirm: probe the box →
    identify the source instance/db + its filestore + its addons_path + Odoo version
    (REFUSES if < 16.3, which has no native `odoo neutralize`) → compute the staging
    instance (slug default `<source>-staging`, db `<source_db>_staging`, first free
    port pair) → pg_dump+restore the db as a FRESH copy owned by odoo + copy the
    filestore → render+write the staging odoo.conf (SAME addons_path as source),
    systemd unit and nginx site → run `odoo neutralize` against the STAGING db ONLY
    (crons off, mail servers off, payment providers → test) BEFORE starting it →
    start the service. NO nightly backup (staging is ephemeral). `plan` describes the
    staging instance (its staging subdomain, tls_mode, edition/version matching the
    source). dry_run shows every file + the exact bash (pg_dump/restore/filestore/
    neutralize/start); confirm builds it. Passwords load from `secrets_path` (default
    secrets_<slug>.json), never shown. Expose it afterwards with cloudflare_apply +
    access_app_create (Cloudflare Access, owner-email only) - see the returned steps.
name: staging
